plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Gives every project folder its own memory in .project-memory/: created on the first session in a folder, loaded automatically on every session after, and shared by anyone who opens the folder.

plugins.name: research-log
plugins.description: Keeps a documentary of how a project was built (stuck points, ideas and who proposed them, decisions, dead ends) for a later research paper. Mirrors session transcripts into the project, extracts a journal, index and stats with no model calls, and never adds a turn.
